samples.summary: New slide-inline validation (`assertValidSlideInlines`) ships with no test in the slides arm of the controller spec

The `slides body shape validation` describe block (spec lines 616-1027) has cases for `style.alignment`, `style.marginTop`, `style.lineHeight`, `style.textIndent`, notes, group children, layout placeholders/staticElements, and a positive case that omits `inlines` entirely (line 1008) — but not a single case asserting a malformed inline is rejected through the slides path. finding.summary: setBlockType's switch from a path-range removal to the node-scoped removeNodeStyle has no test
finding.evidence: The diff changes three removal sites from `removeStyleByPath(path, path+1, …)` to `removeNodeStyle` and documents the bug being fixed ("on a table block it would also strip `listKind`/`listLevel`/`headingLevel` from every block nested in its cells"). Two of the three sites got dedicated nested-preservation regressions in packages/frontend/tests/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.test.ts ('should not strip backgroundColor from nodes inside the cell', 'should clear colSpan in the CRDT without touching nested cells'). The setBlockType site (line 1459) got none: the `describe('setBlockType')` block (test file lines 1868-1969) only covers a plain block losing listKind/listLevel and a cell-internal block being retyped — nothing sets a table block's type while nested list-item blocks exist inside its cells, so the exact regression the comment describes would pass unnoticed.

verdict.reason: A dedicated nested-preservation regression for the setBlockType removal site does exist: yorkie-doc-store.test.ts:1975-1999, 'should not strip list/heading attrs from blocks nested in its cells'. It is the final test in the describe('setBlockType') block (which closes at line 2000), just past the 1868-1969 range the reviewer read. It builds a table whose cell blocks are a list-item (listKind 'ordered', listLevel 1) and a heading (headingLevel 2), calls store.setBlockType(tableBlock.id, 'table') — which yields toRemove = ['headingLevel','listKind','listLevel'] per yorkie-doc-store.ts:1442-1444 and thus exercises removeNodeStyle at yorkie-doc-store.ts:1459 — then re-reads through a fresh YorkieDocStore(doc) to bypass the cache and asserts the nested attributes survive. Under the old path-range removal those assertions would fail, so the coverage is meaningful, not vacuous.
